text: 4.94 Filing of Annual RODTEP Return (ARR) 4.94 Filing of Annual RODTEP Return (ARR) 1. To assess the nature of inputs used in export production and the amount of actual taxes & duties incurred, as permissible under Para 4.54 of FTP, the exporters claiming RODTEP benefits shall be required to file an Annual RODTEP Return (ARR) as per the format given under Appendix-4RR of Handbook of Procedures, 2023. The Annual RODTEP Return (ARR) for Ro DTEP claims filed in a particular financial year shall be filed on DGFT portal by 31st March of the next financial year i.e. RODTEP claims information for Financial Year 2023-24 shall be required to be filed by 31.03.2025. This requirement for filing the annual return to begin with the exporters (IECs) whose total Ro DTEP claim exceeds Rs. 1 crore in a financial year across all 8-digit HS Codes.
